about_the_game:
Game Introduction | Godslayer: Moon Cleaver

In the world of Godslayer: Moon Cleaver, the gods have fallen into chaos, the moonlight is corrupted by evil forces, and the mortal realm has descended into turmoil. You will take on the role of a hero wielding a sacred sword, embarking on a journey to slay gods and cleave the moon, fighting to save the world.

Core Gameplay

(1) Integration of Strategic Matching and Combat

The game adopts an innovative strategic matching combat mode. The screen is filled with colored screws representing different divine powers (such as pink, yellow, and blue rune-like screws). You need to skillfully click and match the screws as if solving an intricate mechanism.

(2) Level Challenges and Progression

Starting from basic levels, more difficult levels will be unlocked as you progress through the game. Each level features a unique arrangement of screws. These screws can be used to unlock "Expansion Slots" (to add an extra placement space), "Clear Screws" (to remove excess screws), and "Remove Blockers" (to break through obstacles).

Highlight Features

(1) Stunning Visuals and Immersive Atmosphere

The game’s visuals are based on cool-toned colors, complemented by the brilliant glow of colored rune-like screws, creating a mysterious and tense atmosphere of god-slaying. The arrangement and combination of the screws resemble a mystical divine formation; every match is accompanied by dazzling light effects. While engaging in strategic thinking, you can also enjoy a visual spectacle, as if truly contending with the power of the gods.

(2) Diverse Items and Strategic Depth

In addition to screw matching, the game also offers items like "Unlock Chests," which provide a free space to generate a screw socket. You need to flexibly use functions such as "Expansion Slots," "Clear Screws," and "Remove Blockers" based on the challenges of different levels, formulating exclusive strategies. Using items to break through difficult situations quickly, every choice may influence the course of the game.
